name: Readout
summary: Reporting app for an e-bike subscription business: report builder, cohorts, plans and live fleet
about: A complete reporting and analytics app for a subscription business, shown with sample data for a made-up e-bike subscription company in Lahore, Karachi and Islamabad. Build your own reports from widgets you drag into order, then save, export or schedule them, and follow MRR, riders, plans, cohorts, rides and a live fleet of bikes. Swiss paper style by day, ink by night.
how: On Reports, drag a widget by its grip to reorder (the others slide into place), or use the arrow buttons. Add widgets from the list and change metric, chart type, width and range.
Save several reports, rename or delete them, export a CSV or schedule a send by email.
Overview reads the business in one paragraph, with a 3M, 6M and 12M switch that morphs the charts.
Subscribers has search, chips, sorting and a drawer to change plan, cancel with undo or reactivate.
Fleet shows every bike's battery live; charging bikes fill up. Open a bike to send it to repair or charge it.
Cohorts, Plans and Rides cover retention, pricing and when people ride. Settings switches the theme and resets the demo.
